title: NVRAM Service Component
text: Configure AUTOSAR NVRAM Services and Runtime Environment (RTE) for emulation; {Block ID} sets the iD that identifies service block, {Maximum number of memory blocks} and {Initial Value} sets the initial values of NvM client ports. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Block ID
params.values: ID that identifies service block 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum number of memory blocks
params.values: Maximum number of memory blocks to use in NvM service operations 10 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial Value
params.values: Initial values of NvM client ports 0 (default) | real, finite scalar or vector
